title: chrysothamnus parryi subsp. howardii
intro: Chrysothamnus parryi subsp. howardii, commonly known as the Howards Chrysanthemum or Howards Desert Chrysanthemum, is a plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Chrysothamnus parryi subsp. howardii are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce pain and inflammation, and promote wound healing. Bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
